baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَلَقَّوْنَهُۥ بِأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَتَقُولُونَ بِأَفْوَاهِكُم ... مَّا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: The syntax routes the report from reception directly to tongue and mouth while explicitly denying epistemic possession; the organ of output has become the receiving surface, so circulation outruns cognition.

activation_trace.role: Taking up and learning speech supplies the intake stage of the relay.
The tongue as speech organ is made, unusually, the stated surface of reception.
Bringing words out in speech supplies immediate retransmission.
Opening the mouth in speech supplies the relay's outlet.
Knowledge as disclosure to a knower is negated, marking the skipped checkpoint.

changed_reading.after: You became a nearly frictionless oral relay: the report landed on the speaking organ and exited through the mouth before becoming knowledge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بِأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ ... بِأَفْوَاهِكُم ... لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: Tongue, mouth, and absent knowledge form a staged anatomy: language occupies an external organ and passes an aperture, while the inward, unexpressed or knowing stage is missing.

activation_trace.role: Tongue as language, report, and circulating speech supplies the verbal surface.
The mouth as an opening or outlet turns speech into exterior discharge.
The branch of unexpressed inner speech supplies the interior stage whose epistemic equivalent is absent here.
Present-state negation seals the lack of inward knowledge.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the missing interior possession.

changed_reading.before: Tongues and mouths are redundant emphases for speaking.
changed_reading.after: The doubled anatomy diagrams exterior speech without an interior warrant: language reaches the outlet while knowledge never becomes present.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَتَحْسَبُونَهُۥ هَيِّنًۭا وَهُوَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ عَظِيمٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: A subjective estimate assigns lightness or ease, then the construction relocates the same act into God's evaluative presence and gives it magnitude; the contrast is not only emotion but a clash of measures.

activation_trace.role: Supposition supplies the fallible private estimate.
Counting and calculation give that estimate the functional shape of valuation.
Lightness and ease supply the low human valuation.
Presence and standing at a locus supply the alternate divine forum.
Greatness and force supply the weight that overturns the human estimate.

changed_reading.before: You underestimated how serious the statement was.
changed_reading.after: You priced the utterance on a private scale as nearly weightless, while in the divine forum it already had force and magnitude.

context_deltas.mechanism: The legal sequence casts accusation as a verbal projectile and testimony as declaration grounded in knowledge. The focus speech therefore functions as de facto accusation or testimony that entered circulation without the required evidentiary carrier and is classified in the same divine forum.

activation_trace.role: Saying what did not occur or attributing it to another anchors the focus speech as allegation.
Knowledge is the expressly absent warrant.
Verbal casting supplies the projectile mechanism of accusation.
Declaration based on knowledge supplies the evidentiary threshold that the focus speech lacks.
Standing in God's presence repeats the forum that later measures the focus utterance.
Contradiction of truth supplies the verdict when witnesses are absent.

structural_cues: Ayat 24:4 and 24:13 bracket the allegation with a four-witness requirement and the verdict `عند الله ... الكاذبون`; 24:15 repeats the divine forum after naming knowledge as absent.
The focus moves from oral handling to divine valuation inside a passage that has already formalized admissible speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies verbal throwing, knowledge-based testimony, failed witnesses, and the repeated divine forum; I infer that circulating the report performs an informal accusation. A live alternative is that 24:15 rebukes social repetition outside the formal testimonial act.

changed_reading.before: The fault is loose, unverified talk.
changed_reading.after: Each repetition acts like a thrown allegation claiming testimonial force, yet it arrives without the knowledge and witnesses required to carry that force.

context_deltas.mechanism: The report moves through a bound group, but collective circulation does not dissolve agency: each participant acquires a portion of guilt while one participant bears the main share. The plural mouths form a network with individually posted and asymmetrically distributed liability.

activation_trace.role: Speech circulating among people anchors the networked act.
An encircling, mutually supporting group supplies the social topology.
Personal acquisition turns each participation into something posted to its agent.
Loading and counting guilt supplies the liability attached to acquisition.
The main bulk of an affair supplies asymmetric responsibility within the group.

structural_cues: Ayah 24:11 names a group, then allocates `لكل امرئ` a personal acquisition before singling out the bearer of the largest share.
The second-person plurals of 24:15 place multiple tongues and mouths inside that already differentiated group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies group cohesion, individual acquisition of guilt, and a largest share; I model the speakers as relay nodes and infer that diffusion does not dilute responsibility. Alternatively, the allocation may describe guilt without implying a transmission topology.

changed_reading.before: A crowd collectively passed on the report.
changed_reading.after: A bound group transmitted it, but every mouth acquired its own liability and the network retained an identifiable heavier node.

context_deltas.mechanism: The counterfactual responses route the report through hearing before speech: hearing should produce charitable judgment, identification of falsehood, and refusal to speak it. This exposes `تلقونه بألسنتكم` as a malformed reception path in which the tongue bypasses the listening and judging gate.

activation_trace.role: Taking up speech anchors the focus's abnormal reception stage.
Auditory reception supplies the proper bodily inlet before judgment.
The resulting utterance names the report as manifest falsehood instead of relaying it.
Hearing as understanding and responsive compliance supplies an interruptive uptake.
Meaningful speech connecting speakers is explicitly refused for this content.
A lie that overwhelms speaker or hearer supplies the classification that should halt transmission.

structural_cues: Both 24:12 and 24:16 repeat `إذ سمعتموه` before a required saying; 24:15 instead says `إذ تلقونه بألسنتكم`.
The counterfactual pipeline is hearing, evaluation, then corrective speech or refusal; the actual pipeline is tongue-reception, mouth-output, and absent knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the parallel temporal clauses and contrasting organs and responses; I infer two competing reception pipelines. A live alternative is that `تلقونه` merely denotes rapid repetition without a deliberate ear-versus-tongue anatomy.

changed_reading.before: The speakers failed to verify what they heard.
changed_reading.after: They replaced hearing as an interpretive gate with tongue-level uptake, eliminating the pause in which falsehood could be recognized and speech refused.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding verbs render discourse as a medium that overflows and diffuses. The focus's tongue-to-mouth sequence is one local conduit in a collective expansion whose social spread is itself the consequential act.

activation_trace.role: Taking up speech supplies entry into each local conduit.
Speech spreading among people anchors the circulating output.
The expansion of speech and news like overflow supplies the hydraulic propagation mechanism.
Diffusion and widespread dispersal make social spread an explicit outcome.

structural_cues: The plural `أفضتم` immediately precedes the focus's plural oral verbs.
Ayah 24:19 later makes the spread of the obscenity, not only its first formulation, an object of desire and sanction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies discourse-overflow, oral conduits, and later diffusion; I join them into one propagation mechanism. They could instead be separate descriptions of discussion and of the allegation's broader social consequence.

changed_reading.before: Individuals repeated a rumor one after another.
changed_reading.after: Each tongue and mouth became an intake and discharge point in an expanding flow, so the offense included making the report socially pervasive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same tongue first appears as a supposedly passive channel and later as an autonomous witness concerning deeds. The bodily instrument reverses roles, turning ephemeral output into recoverable evidence against its operator.

activation_trace.role: The tongue as speech organ anchors the instrument used in the focus.
The tongue as witness supplies the explicit reversal from instrument to evidence.
The repeated bodily organ binds the later witness scene back to the focus anatomy.
Intentional deed classifies oral output as accountable action rather than vanishing sound.

structural_cues: Ayah 24:24 repeats `ألسنتهم` and coordinates tongues with hands and feet as witnesses.
Its testimony concerns what the speakers used to do, converting the focus's speech event into embodied action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact organ's recurrence and its later witness role; I infer retrospective relevance to the earlier misuse of tongues. The later testimony may also encompass deeds far beyond this report.

changed_reading.before: The tongue is a passive tool whose speech disappears after transmission.
changed_reading.after: The tongue records its own use: the channel that carried unsupported speech later returns as a witness that makes the act evidentially present.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mirage scene turns the focus's evaluative contrast into a temporal process: subjective reckoning mistakes appearance for substance, encounter dissolves the estimate, and the same root returns as complete accounting in God's presence.

activation_trace.role: Supposition anchors the focus's mistaken estimate of lightness.
Standing in God's presence anchors the forum that overturns the estimate.
A mirage appearing as water supplies the model of persuasive but empty valuation.
The first use supplies subjective supposition within the occurrence record that later turns to account.
The later account nouns convert private estimation into objective counting and settlement.
Finding nothing and then finding God supplies the collapse and replacement of the apparent object.
Presence at the object repeats the divine locus of true valuation.
Full completion without deficiency supplies the final settlement of the account.

structural_cues: In 24:39 one root occurrence record spans `يحسبه`, `حسابه`, and `الحساب`, making the shift from estimate to accounting packet-visible.
The sequence `وجده ... ووجد الله عنده فوفاه حسابه` restages the focus's movement from human reckoning to standing with God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared roots, mirage, failed finding, divine presence, and completed account; I infer that 24:39 materializes the focus's misvaluation mechanism. The mirage directly concerns deeds of disbelievers, so the analogy need not be exclusive to rumor.

changed_reading.before: Human and divine judgments simply disagree about the utterance's size.
changed_reading.after: The light estimate behaves like a mirage: it seems adequate only before encounter, then vanishes as subjective `حسب` becomes the fully settled `حساب` in God's presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later speech is tested by enacted alignment: a verbal claim to belief and obedience is negated by turning away, genuine believer-speech joins hearing to obedience, and strenuous oath is displaced by recognizable obedience known through action. Mouth-output is therefore not self-authenticating.

activation_trace.role: Externally produced speech anchors the focus's unsupported output.
Speech as professed belief supplies a verbal identity claim.
Heart-settling assent supplies what the verbal claim fails to establish by itself.
Obedient compliance supplies the action asserted by the mouth.
Turning away supplies behavior that falsifies the preceding verbal alignment.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies valid uptake.
Obedience immediately coupled to hearing supplies speech ratified by response.
A solemn oath supplies intensified mouth-output that is nevertheless refused.
Recognizable good supplies the requested alternative to verbal intensity.
Knowledge of the report's inward reality supplies divine access beyond claims.
Intentional action supplies the observable test of speech.

structural_cues: Ayah 24:47 places saying before a behavioral reversal and then denies the speakers' claimed identity.
Ayah 24:51 joins `سمعنا وأطعنا`, while 24:53 rejects maximal oath in favor of `طاعة معروفة` and closes with knowledge of deeds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies claim, reversal, responsive obedience, rejected oath, and known action; I infer a surah-wide authenticity test for mouth-speech. Alternatively, these later scenes concern covenantal obedience rather than the epistemic warrant of the earlier rumor.

changed_reading.before: The focus condemns speech because its content was not known.
changed_reading.after: It also exposes mouth-speech as evidentially weak on its own: utterance becomes credible only when inward assent and enacted response align with it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later communication scene assigns a messenger, a bounded burden to each party, and clear delivery. It distinguishes accountable transmission from ownerless circulation: the focus does not condemn all relaying, but relaying severed from source, mandate, and carried responsibility.

activation_trace.role: Receiving and learning speech anchors the focus as a transmission event.
Messenger and message supply an identified source and authorized communicative role.
Bearing a trust or burden assigns distinct responsibility to sender and receivers.
Delivering a message supplies the legitimate endpoint of transmission.
Clarifying meaning by word or sign supplies transparency of content.

structural_cues: Ayah 24:54 distributes `ما حمل` and `ما حملتم` between messenger and audience before naming clear delivery.
This role-bounded chain contrasts with 24:15, where speech is taken up mouth-to-mouth with no knowledge named for its carriers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies authorized messenger, separate burdens, and clear delivery; I contrast that chain with the focus's ungrounded relay and infer that provenance and role matter. The later verse primarily defines prophetic duty, so this contrast remains analogical.

changed_reading.before: Passing speech onward is itself the problem.
changed_reading.after: The problem is unaccountable transmission: legitimate delivery has a known source, a bounded trust, clear content, and named responsibility at each end.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the packet's `ق و ل` inventory splits to a form-distant `ق ل ل` target; it is not an ordinary derivation of `تقولون`. It remains anchored at that exact focus word and is reinforced by the explicit `هينا` versus `عظيم` reversal. Downstream prose should call it an experimental branch or sonic shadow, never the lexical meaning of the verb.

activation_trace.role: The split target's smallness and slightness cast an exploratory littleness shadow inside the act of saying.
Explicit lightness makes the form-distant shadow locally visible rather than free-floating.
Greatness supplies the verse's overt reversal of that littleness.

changed_reading.before: They spoke the report and separately judged it light.
changed_reading.after: At the exploratory branch level, the saying itself carries a shadow of making-little that the verse immediately overturns as great.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading treats speech reception as boundary crossing, which is surprising because 24:27-28 literally regulate entry into houses. It remains anchored in the focus's intake and mouth-outlet construction and in the later sequence of entry, permission, and return. Render only as a spatial heuristic for epistemic custody, not as an equation between rumor law and house law.

activation_trace.role: Taking speech in supplies the focus's reception boundary.
The mouth as opening or outlet gives that boundary a bodily aperture.
Entry into an interior supplies the spatial analogue for admitting content.
The protected dwelling supplies a bounded interior rather than an open conduit.
Permission supplies a gatekeeping condition for crossing the boundary.
Returning what cannot enter supplies the alternative to automatic uptake.

changed_reading.before: The mouth receives and forwards whatever reaches it.
changed_reading.after: Speech intake can be imagined as entry into a protected interior: unsupported content lacks permission and should be turned back rather than housed and reissued.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a deliberately cross-domain meteorological activation: 24:43 describes clouds and rain, not rumor. It remains anchored in the focus's receive-and-emit chain because the packet supplies driving, joining, stacking, and issuing as one ordered material mechanism. Downstream prose should mark it as an analogy for emergent accumulation, not an asserted symbolic gloss.

activation_trace.role: Circulating speech anchors the social material to which the analogy is applied.
Gentle driving supplies movement of initially separate units.
Joining one thing to another supplies aggregation across relays.
Layered accumulation supplies emergent mass beyond any single contribution.
Falling rain supplies consequential discharge from the accumulated mass.
Passage to the outside supplies the mouth-like exit from accumulation.

changed_reading.before: Rumor propagation is a linear handoff between speakers.
changed_reading.after: Each small handoff can join and stack with others until collective speech condenses into a consequential discharge that no single mouth visually contains.

strongest_changes: The legal frame recasts unsupported repetition as evidence-bearing verbal accusation rather than merely careless conversation.
The repeated `إذ سمعتموه` clauses expose a proper hearing-and-judgment gate that tongue-level reception bypasses.
Overflow and diffusion turn plural mouths into a propagation medium while 24:11 preserves personal and asymmetric liability inside the group.
The later tongue-witness scene makes oral output an embodied deed that can return as evidence.
The mirage sequence develops `حسب` from fallible estimate into completed `حساب` in the same divine presence.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence connected anatomy, legal proof, social spread, action, and accounting without forcing them into one final interpretation. The focus ayah became simultaneously a malformed communication pipeline, an inadmissible accusation, a distributed liability event, and a collision between private estimate and divine reckoning.
remaining_uncertainties: The ear-versus-tongue pipeline may be a deliberate anatomical contrast or an intensified idiom for rapid repetition.
The mirage, permission, and cloud mechanisms are packet-anchored analogies, but their intended intra-surah force remains uncertain.
The `ق ل ل` activation under the split `ق و ل` inventory is form-distant experimental evidence and must not be treated as etymology.
